symptom: An app module with no documentation is never reported by QUAL002, although docs-site/src/tools/starlark-rules.md lists a check_modules option for it
cause: The option was documented but the rule never iterated modules(); the documentation drifted ahead of the rule
insight: A module's documentation is its domain model's (modules_data.DomainModelDocumentation), not modules_data.Description, which Mendix never fills: an existing test set Description and believed the module documented. Check a documented option against the rule body, not just the table
